prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE square transparent Minecraft 16x16 ore overlay authored from large hard-edged square logical cells.
Primary request: Ironstone FRAGMENT independent variant 2. Depict a local, short oolitic sedimentary lens with a broad blunt shoulder and one sharply pinched stepped tip. Its left fuller shoulder contains a coherent dark oolitic grain pocket; the tip steps UP one logical row. ONE lens only, no attached second pod or full bed.
Scene/backdrop: real alpha-zero transparency outside the mineral, no host stone, deepslate, matte or checkerboard.
Style/medium: coarse 16x16 pixel art using large square opaque cells approximately 1/16 canvas width; flat earthy values, no fine painting.
Composition/framing: a connected shape roughly FIVE logical cells long and TWO to THREE cells thick in the shoulder, tapering at the last two cells; target about 16–22 visible center-sampled cells, minimum 10 and at least 6 connected. Large clear empty canvas all around. This is a short partial patch, not a long horizontal route. Edge contact optional. Structurally differs from retained0 and new1 through upward stepped pinch and localized oolite pocket.
Materials/textures: subdued medium gray-ochre/brown #7b7366 and #8b7d69, a few darker oolitic cells inside the fuller shoulder. No orange blob or outlines.
Constraints: one 1:1 square PNG >=1024x1024 with genuine transparent alpha, mineral only, no algorithmic repair, no label or panel.
Avoid: too tiny 1–8-cell nugget, two linked pods, broad full-width stripe, bright rust border, confetti, halo, smooth gradient, glow.
